title: BOS-692 — narrow Home reserves the fully wrapped retained re-login warning below a populated session board

scenes.title: Home fits its populated board, action bar, and soft-wrapped retained-login warning inside a sub-60-column terminal

waitFor.label: the retained re-login warning is visible below the populated Home board

steps.caption: The narrow PTY forces the warning to soft-wrap; Home reserves its rendered height instead of overlapping the board.
The retained re-login warning stays visible while the seeded Home board completes its initial session refresh.

expect.label: the populated session board remains visible
the warning is not clipped by the board footer
the login remedy remains visible in the action bar and warning

steps.caption: Board, warning, and remedy stay in non-overlapping order inside the narrow Home frame.
